notes: Read all 66 source lines line by line before editing. The web file exports two hooks: useNavigationGuard (L23-38) and useGuardedNavigate (L50-66), backed by the global <NavigationGuardProvider> context and react-router-dom navigation.

Documented via nativeNavigationGuardCapabilities.reactRouterNavigateAvailable=false / injectableNavigatorAvailable=true.

This keeps the web end-to-end behaviour (an imperative guarded navigate consults the very guards registered by useNavigationGuard). The NavigationGuardEntry shape ({id,isDirty,getMessage}) the web hook constructs at L33-35 is exported here to match the provider contract.
